# Commerce and marketplaces

## Scope

Applies when the change touches orders, stock, sellers, or reviews. Not when the product sells nothing and hosts no other seller. Neighbours: `aidd-team:payments-and-finance`, `aidd-team:privacy-by-default`, `aidd-team:concurrency`.

## Terms

- **Marketplace and merchant of record**: A marketplace hosts other sellers' offers; the merchant of record sells.
- **Trader**: A seller acting for business purposes, whom a marketplace must trace under the DSA.
- **SKU and listing**: A SKU is one product variant; a listing is one seller's offer of it.
- **Hold**: Stock set aside for a cart or an order, released when it expires.
- **Return and refund**: The goods coming back, and the money going back: either can happen without the other.
- **Incentivised review**: A review written in exchange for something of value, which must say so.
- **Deemed supplier**: A marketplace the tax law treats as the seller, so it charges and pays the VAT (EU).

## Dated obligations

| From | Obligation | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2023-06-27 | The INFORM Consumers Act applies: a US marketplace collects, verifies, and discloses its high-volume third-party sellers' details. | S3 |
| 2024-10-21 | The FTC rule on consumer reviews and testimonials is in effect: no fake, bought, or insider reviews, and no review suppression. | S4 |
| 2024-12-13 | The GPSR applies: an EU marketplace registers on Safety Gate, names a single point of contact, and acts on recalls and takedown orders. | S2 |
| 2025-05-12 | US: the FTC fees rule applies to live-event tickets and short-term lodging: the total price, mandatory fees included, shows first. | S4 |
| 2025-06-28 | The European Accessibility Act applies to e-commerce services sold to consumers in the EU. | S5 |
| 2026-06-19 | EU: an online contract with a right of withdrawal offers the withdrawal function. | S7 |

## Invariants and missed cases

| Always true | The case a plan misses |
| --- | --- |
| Stock never goes below zero across concurrent checkouts. | Two carts buying the last unit, or a hold that expired but was never released. |
| An order's total equals its lines, discounts, tax, and shipping, in one currency. | A coupon applied again after a partial refund or a split shipment. |
| A review is shown only when a real customer wrote it, marked when incentivised. | A seller's staff posting reviews, or negative reviews suppressed. |
| A seller is verified before it sells, and again when its details change. | A seller changing its bank account after verification. |
| The first price shown is the total the buyer pays, mandatory fees included. | A service fee added at the last step, against US fee rules for tickets and lodging. |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before the first edit (`aidd gate --paths`) | A marketplace with other sellers: trader traceability, product safety, and seller verification are in scope. Name the markets the change serves. | S1, S3 |
| Specify | The order's states and transitions in one state machine, with the stock hold and its expiry; every total named in minor units with its currency. | S6 |
| Specify | A seller's identity, bank, and contact details are verified before its first sale and again on a change; the traders' details are shown to buyers. A change to sellers' terms gives at least 15 days' notice, and a restriction gives its reasons (EU P2B). | S1, S3, S7 |
| Specify | Name who charges and pays VAT or sales tax in each market: the marketplace as deemed supplier (EU) or marketplace facilitator (US states), or the seller. | S8 |
| Implement | Reviews come only from verified orders or say why not; an incentivised review is marked; no review is hidden for its rating. The first price shown is the total, mandatory fees included (US fee rules). | S4 |
| Implement | A recall or a takedown order removes the listing and notifies its buyers; the checkout meets the accessibility law of each market. | S2, S5 |
| Implement | EU: a price cut names the lowest price of the prior 30 days; a review page says whether and how reviews are checked; search results state their main ranking parameters. | S7 |
| Implement | EU: an online contract with a withdrawal right offers a withdrawal function ('withdraw from contract here') for the whole withdrawal period, then 'confirm withdrawal' and an acknowledgement. | S7 |
| Review | Concurrent checkouts of the last unit, an expired hold, and a refund after a split shipment each have a test. | S6 |
| Roll out | Oversell, stuck orders, and refund failures are rollback triggers; the reconciliation of orders, payments, and stock is the observe signal. | S6 |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Oversell race test | concurrent checkouts never sell more than the stock | parallel checkout requests against the last units, in an integration test | S6 |
| Order state machine tests | every order event moves only along an allowed transition, once | property-based tests over event sequences, duplicates and out-of-order events included | S6 |
| Seller verification tests | an unverified or changed seller cannot list or be paid | integration tests over onboarding and detail changes | S3, S1 |
| Review provenance tests | a review shows only with a verified order or its disclosure, whatever its rating | integration tests over review submission and display | S4 |
| Recall takedown test | a recalled product leaves search and checkout, and its buyers are notified | an end-to-end test from the recall event | S2 |
| Withdrawal function test | the withdrawal function works for the whole withdrawal period and sends an acknowledgement on a durable medium | an end-to-end test per EU market, from the order page to the acknowledgement | S7 |

- From `aidd-team:payments-and-finance`: Idempotency and replay tests.

## Keep it current

Each entry is due after its `review_every_days` (else emerging 90 days, established 365) or by its `review_due`. An emerging one applies only when the change needs it, said in the Spec. One `aidd eval standards` lists as due is looked up in Specify, and a missing one is proposed to aidd's `schemas/industry-standards.json`.
